title: Skeletal Muscle Index and Baseline Biomarkers in Atezolizumab-Treated Extensive-Stage Small-Cell Lung Cancer: A Real-World Cohort Study.
snippet: Body composition and routinely available blood biomarkers may help characterize prognosis in extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC). We retrospectively evaluated 81 patients who received first-line carboplatin, etoposide, and atezolizumab.
